info.title: Banking System API Documentation
info.description: OpenAPI Documentation for a Banking System project

post.summary: Allows user to create new funds transfer to destined account in a system
post.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Attempts to create new transfer from an account belonging to authenticated user, with destination and amount of funds specified in the body

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account set to be a sender of a transfer. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

402.description: Account has no sufficient amount of funds for a transfer

404.description: No account with given sender ID found for the user or no account found for given receiver ID

409.description: Sender or receiver account are not eligible for a transfer

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

post.summary: Registers new user to the system
post.description: Registers new account using credentials present in request body
Invalidates sent "refresh_token" cookie and removes it from browser.  "refresh_token" value is read from HTTP Cookies
Attempts to log in user with credentials provided in request body, on success returns JWT and attaches "refresh_token" for further session authentication

200.description: Sends initial JWT and sets "refresh_token" cookie

post.summary: Resolves ticket with a valid resolution type
post.description: REQUIRED ROLE [ADMIN] - Resolves ticket giving it either ACCEPTED or DECLINED status. If ticket gets accepted, then account requesting change gets it's status changed accordingly

404.description: No ticket found for given UUID

409.description: Ticket either not selected for manual resolution, ticket is already resolved or account status doesnt match a requested change

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

post.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Creates new account for authenticated user, if said user doesn't currently have other non-closed account

409.description: Account couldn't be created, because user already has an active or frozen account

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

post.summary: Allows user to claim signing bonus for selected account
post.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Claims signing bonus on selected account, if it belongs to the user and user haven't already claimed the bonus

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account selected for bonus claim. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

200.description: Information about attempt at claiming bonus

404.description: No account with given ID found for the user.

409.description: Cannot claim bonus for frozen or closed accounts

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

post.summary: Requests given status change on selected account
post.description: Requests given status change for selected account, either done by account owner or account with ADMIN role

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account for status change. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

404.description: ROLE [USER]: No account with given ID found for the user. ROLE [ADMIN]: No account with given ID found

409.description: Illegal state shift requested for account (ex. CLOSE -> FROZEN), or attempt at closing account with funds

get.summary: Allows user to get list of transfers connected to their account
get.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Returns a part of paginated response with given size (1-20, higher values will be reduced to the max of a range) consisting of transfers information for account belonging to authenticated user. If next page exists, field "cursor" in response has a value that can be used as a starting point for next page if passed as "cursor" request parameter

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account for getting transfers list. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Amount of records in a page (1-20, greater values are reduced to the top of the range)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor pointing at the start of selected page. Omit to start from first page. Cursor for next page is returned by response (null if no next page)

200.description: Page for all transfers that include selected account

404.description: No account with given ID found for the user or no record found for given cursor

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

get.summary: Allows user to check current balance for one of their accounts
get.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Returns balance for an existing account if it belongs to currently authenticated user

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account for getting balance. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

200.description: Information about balance of an account

404.description: No account with given ID found for the user.

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

get.description: Sends new JWT in response if "refresh_token" cookie is present in request and is currently valid. "refresh_token" value is read from HTTP Cookies

get.summary: Returns list of all tickets requesting manually resolved status change
get.description: REQUIRED ROLE [ADMIN] - Returns a part of paginated response with given size (1-10, higher values will be reduced to the max of a range) consisting of status change requests, that require manual confirmation. If next page exists, field "cursor" in response has a value that can be used as a starting point for next page if passed as "cursor" request parameter

parameters.name: requestType
parameters.description: Request type to filter for. If not specified, response will include all possible options

parameters.name: resolutionStatus
parameters.description: Resolution status to filter for. If not specified, response will include all possible options

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Amount of records in a page (1-10, greater values are reduced to the top of the range)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor pointing at the start of selected page. Omit to start from first page. Cursor for next page is returned by response (null if no next page)

200.description: Page for all status change logs with MANUAL resolution

404.description: No record found for given cursor

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

get.summary: Returns the list of all accounts belonging to user and their statuses
get.description: REQUIRED ROLE [USER] - Returns complete list of all accounts assigned to user with their current status

200.description: Statuses of all accounts belonging to user

403.description: Currently authenticated user is not authorized

get.description: Returns status for requested account, if it belongs to currently authenticated user or request comes from account with an ADMIN role

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account for status check. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

200.description: Status of an account requested by user

404.description: ROLE [USER]: No account with given ID found for the user. ROLE [ADMIN]: No account with given ID found

get.summary: Returns lists of all status changes requested for selected account
get.description: Returns a part of paginated response with given size (1-10, higher values will be reduced to the max of a range) consisting of status change requests for selected account. If next page exists, field "cursor" in response has a value that can be used as a starting point for next page if passed as "cursor" request parameter

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of an account for getting status change logs. Returned by "/account/create" or "/account/statuses"

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Amount of records in a page (1-10, greater values are reduced to the top of the range)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor pointing at the start of selected page. Omit to start from first page. Cursor for next page is returned by response (null if no next page)

200.description: Page of status change logs for selected account

404.description: ROLE [USER]: No account with given ID found for the user or no record found for given cursor. ROLE [ADMIN]: No account with given ID found or no record found for given cursor

TransferRequest.description: Creates new outgoing transfer in a system from an ACTIVE account

amount.description: Amount of funds to be transferred. Requires sender to have balance greater or equal than given amount, for initial balance use "/account/claim-bonus". Max 12 integer digits and 2 fraction digits

receiver.description: Account ID of receiver. Account has to exist in a system, have an ACTIVE status and be different then sender

senderAccountId.description: ID of an account sending funds

receiverAccountId.description: ID of an account receiving funds

amount.description: Amount of funds sent in a transfer

timestamp.description: Date of when exception happened (UTC time)

status.description: HTTP error code of an exception (4xx/5xx)

path.description: URI path of a request that triggered exception

timestamp.description: Date of when exception happened (UTC time)

status.description: HTTP error code of an exception (4xx/5xx)

path.description: URI path of a request that triggered exception

errors.description: List of fields that validation did not pass on together with list of descriptions for not fulfilled requirements

username: Username can only consist of letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens

RegisterRequest.description: Registration form. After success you can authenticate with your credentials under "auth/login" endpoint

username.description: Unique username consisting only of letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens. Case insensitive.

password.description: Password that does not exceed 72 bytes

LoginRequest.description: Login form to an existing account. Account can be registered under "auth/register" endpoint

jwt.description: JWT allowing for authentication using "Authorization" : "bearer {token}" header

AccountStatusChangeResolutionRequest.description: Resolution to a PENDING ticket requesting a status change on an account with MANUAL type resolution

uuid.description: UUIDv4 for pending request that is due for manual resolution. Valid UUID is required and one can be extracted from "/admin/status-change-logs/tickets" endpoint response.

resolutionStatus.description: Decision whether ticket is resolved as ACCEPTED or DECLINED. ACCEPTED ticket will automatically assign proper status to requesting account, DECLINED will result in no changes to status

AccountStatusChangeLogInfoDto.description: Single log of account status change

uuid.description: UUIDv4 identifying log. Best way to extract valid UUID for "/admin/status-change-logs/ticket/resolve" endpoint

accountId.description: ID of an account that status change was requested on

requestType.description: Status change requested on an account

requestedBy.description: Tells whether request was done by account owner (USER) or an admin (ADMIN)

reason.description: Reason given for status change by requester. Can be null if none was given

requestDate.description: Date when change was requested (UTC time)

resolutionType.description: Tells whether request was made for automatic (AUTO) resolution or manual (MANUAL)

resolutionStatus.description: Tells whether request was accepted, declined or is still pending resolution

resolutionDate.description: Date when request was resolved (UTC time). Null while pending

AccountCreateResponse.description: Response informing of successful account creation

accountId.description: Account ID assigned to created account

ClaimBonusResponse.description: Informs if sign-in bonus was claimed just now, was claimed before or unavailable for user

accountId.description: ID of an account that bonus claim was attempted for

enum: Bonus is unavailable for this user

AccountStatusChangeRequest.description: Request for performing status change on an account

reason.description: Optional reason for requesting a change

statusChange.description: Status transition desired for an account. FREEZE and CLOSE require ACTIVE account and are executed automatically with CLOSE additionally requiring a balance to be 0, UNFREEZE can be only done on FROZEN account and requires manual admin verification

AccountStatusChangeResponse.description: Confirms successful request of account status change. Does not mean that account change was necessarily done

accountId.description: ID of an account that change was requested on

senderAccountId.description: ID of an account sending funds

receiverAccountId.description: ID of an account receiving funds

amount.description: Amount of funds sent in a transfer

date.description: Date when transfer was created (UTC time)

cursor.description: UUIDv4 pointer at the start of next page, used as cursor query parameter in next request. Cursor equal to null signifies this being a last available page

BalanceResponse.description: Informs about current balance of selected account

accountId.description: ID of an account that this balance belongs to

balance.description: Current account balance with 2 fraction digits

RefreshResponse.description: Informs of a successful JWT refresh

jwt.description: New JWT allowing for authentication using "Authorization" : "bearer {token}" header

AccountStatusChangePageResponse.description: Page response of account status change logs

cursor.description: UUIDv4 pointer at the start of next page, used as cursor query parameter in next request. Cursor equal to null signifies this being a last available page

AccountStatusResponse.description: Informs about current status of an account
